summary: Ancient Indian architectural mysteries like the Lepakshi hanging pillar outperformed general global geography trivia, generating the highest immediate view velocity on the channel. General country trivia like Bhutan traffic signals had slower view traction compared to mystery-driven structural marvels. Shifting focus heavily toward secret ancient Indian engineering feats and extreme geographic anomalies will capitalize on proven multi-million view competitor trends. To accelerate growth, every video must open with an immediate visual shock hook, specific numerical stats, and seamless narration that loops back to the start.
do_more: Focus heavily on ancient Indian architectural marvels with secret engineering angles like Rani Ki Vav, Jagannath Puri, and Konark Sun Temple

avoid: Generic geography facts that lack a strong visual anomaly or explicit mystery element
Slow intros featuring title screens or delay in presenting the core physical anomaly
Overly broad historical storytelling without zooming in on the impossible physical engineering feat
Abrupt video endings that break the continuous narration loop back to the first second
